description:
Priority: P1 | Area: area:workspace | Labels: feat,P1,area:workspace | Milestone: v0.1.0 | RFC: OQ-056 | Task: CTX-0001

Implement the first-party workspace bar in the bar plugin (ADR-0014): pills per workspace with active highlight, click focuses, configurable edge (top/bottom) via plugin settings, show only with >=2 workspaces unless configured, bounded labels. Mirror the retired Core workspaceline. Tests via SDK linter + mock host (SDK pin >= 4f9f1ba7).
title: Workspace bar presentation (ADR-0014 workspaceline parity)

description: Defect proven live: with 3 workspaces, closing #1 leaves Core painting 2:ws2 3:ws3* (stable seq, workspaces.rs workspaceline_tokens renders slot.seq; workspace.list ids are seqs) but plugin paints 1:ws2 2:ws3* (lua/bar/init.lua M.segments uses position index). Fix M.segments to use row.id instead of index. Update reference model (tests/core-workspaceline.ts) and README/comments if they document position labels. Add close-middle-workspace mock-host test asserting stable-seq labels. Scope: one-line-class fix only. Plan: W-104 R1. Live proof reference: bitty@55f9d336 crates/bitty-runtime/src/runtime/workspaces.rs workspaceline_tokens + crates/bitty-terminal/src/plugin_runtime.rs LiveWorkspaces id=row.seq. CTX-0001 is in review on its own worktree; this task uses a separate branch/worktree and does not touch it.
title: Fix bar pill labels position-vs-seq (W-104 R1)

description: Consumer of reviewed Core surface bitty PR #1671 head d749571e (WorkspaceInfo/WorkspaceSummary gain scratchpad_count 0/1 + scratchpad_occupied, notify via existing workspace.changed). Build against reviewed head read-only; rebase after #1671 merges; STOP and report if surface shape changed. Implement scratchpad pill/indicator from workspace state (occupied vs empty; count if meaningful); mock-host tests (occupied/empty/change-event); docs (README scope). Rules: no new capabilities (workspace.list grant only, capability-neutral); no panel capability; English-only; repo gates green. Plan: W-104 R2-consumer. Dependency: bitty#1671 NOT YET MERGED.
title: Render scratchpad indicator in bar (W-104 R2-consumer, DEC-W104-1)
